name: io.github.Savirinc/unfragile
description: Find the AI infrastructure or agent tool for a task, labelled by our checks, with signed receipts.

tools.name: unfragile_find
tools.description: Finds the product, and the specific tool action, that does a task, across AI infrastructure (search APIs, models, inference, browsers, harnesses, compute) and the MCP servers, APIs, CLIs, SDKs and models in our index. Each result carries the label from our checks (verified and signed · official · checked: not enough evidence yet · found in code, not yet checked · demo or tutorial · failed its last check) and a signed receipt. answer: true adds a written, cited answer; false returns the ranked list. A fact we hold (a price, a limit, a model id) arrives in structuredContent.blocks (type 'fact') and at the start of the answer, never in results.

task.description: What you need done, in plain words

answer.description: Also return a written answer: the products that do it, each cited to its maker's own pages. Default here: true (this door has always answered); false lists the products without writing

lane.description: fast: ranked results only · standard: results and a written, cited answer (default) · best: a freshly written answer

search.description: Optional: your own 3-10 word search phrase; skips our reading step

kind.description: With search: 'product' (which product does X), 'action' (the one operation to call) or 'model' (which AI model)

intent.description: Deprecated: the old name of `kind` (kept so 0.10 callers work)

named.description: With search: products the task names, so they lead

max_age.description: Seconds: a remembered answer older than this is written afresh

client_model.description: The model that will read the answer (recorded on the receipt)

session_id.description: Your own id for this task (recorded on the receipt)

tools.name: unfragile_verify
tools.description: Returns our verdict on a tool, MCP server or package (trusted · caution · unverified · flagged) and the reason, with its Ed25519-signed passport, checkable offline against https://unfragile.ai/api/v1/trust-passport-public-key. A flagged verdict means it failed our checks.

target.description: Target identity, e.g. 'npm:@stripe/mcp', a package name, or a record id

tools.name: unfragile_resolve
tools.description: Returns one checked record for a task, with its verdict, its Ed25519-signed passport and a paste-ready install line, or says that nothing qualifies.

intent.description: The task, e.g. 'send a slack message from an agent'

tools.name: unfragile_passport
tools.description: Fetch the raw Ed25519-signed trust passport JSON for a record (by record page slug, record id, or npm package). For programmatic policy checks; verify offline against the published public key.

slug.description: Record page slug, record id (npm:…), or package name
